description: This file defines the `Charting` class which provides methods for creating, displaying, and managing various types of charts using external libraries like Plotly within the OpenBB platform. It includes functionalities for creating line, bar, 3D surface, and correlation matrix charts, as well as styling, toggling themes, and displaying data in tables.

classes.name: Charting
classes.description: Handles creation, display, and management of various chart types, including style and theme toggling for the OpenBB platform.

methods.name: show(self, render: bool = True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Displays the chart and saves it to the associated OBBject.

methods.name: to_chart( self, data: Optional[ Union[ list, dict, "DataFrame", List["DataFrame"], "Series", List["Series"], "ndarray", Data, ] ] = None, target: Optional[str] = None, index: Optional[str] = None, indicators: Optional[Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = None, symbol: str = "", candles: bool = True, volume: bool = True, volume_ticks_x: int = 7, render: bool = True, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Creates an OpenBBFigure with user customizations and populates the OBBject with the chart, either from internal or external data.

methods.description: Returns all available technical indicators for use with charting functions.
